title: D-087 massing pre-wiring 2 (DB-069 a-d; DB-061 b): raw-vertex NYC range check before the collinear collapse, every shapely error typed at the boundary, the missing Y-clause/later-vertex probes, bounded refusal echoes - before the PKT-E scene seam wires user geometry into the massing model
objective: Close the DB-069 before-wiring advisories in services/api/app/scenario/massing_model.py so the PKT-E scene assembler (M5-T107, which depends on this packet) can feed user geometry into the massing model. (a) Range-check the RAW lot vertices against the NYC EPSG:2263 bounds BEFORE the collinear collapse (an out-of-range collinear spike such as x=2e6 must refuse typed, as B0 does). (b) Every shapely error at the boundary becomes a typed MassingModelError - catch shapely.errors.ShapelyError (GEOSException, TopologicalError, GeometryTypeError, DimensionError...) or correct the docstrings to the exact truth. (c) Add the missing probes: an in-X/out-of-Y lot and a lot whose LATER vertex is out of range. (d) Refusal messages echo at most a bounded preview of caller input (a 200,000-character vertex string must not produce a 200,055-character message). DB-061 (b): pin the scan-unit charge order (mutant ME) with a test, or record why it is behaviour-free. Valid-input outputs stay byte-identical.
business_reason: DB-069 routes (a)-(d) to BEFORE any wiring of user geometry into the massing model - the PKT-E scene seam is that wiring, so this small packet unblocks the 3D scene's acceptance.
